summary: Iter 14 — Wired-up /subscription 'Renew Subscription' + 'Contact Support' buttons and full Razorpay TENANT renewal flow. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass against public URL — POST /api/tenants/checkout/order (admin=200 monthly ₹99900 paise & yearly ₹999900 paise, staff=403, no-auth=401, invalid plan=422), POST /api/tenants/checkout/verify (unknown order=404, bad signature=400, valid signature + bogus payment_id=502 gateway, cross-tenant isolation=404 from a fresh signup-tenant, staff=403), GET /api/pay/{order_id} for a tenant order renders 'Salon subscription' label AND POSTs to /api/tenants/checkout/verify (not /branches/), and branch checkout regression still works. Frontend (mobile 390x844): /subscription shows both testIDs (btn-renew-subscription, btn-contact-support) with support email 'support@parlourpilot.com' visible on-screen. Admin clicks Renew → navigates to /checkout?type=tenant with ₹999 monthly and ₹9999 yearly rendered, green 'Secure Razorpay checkout' banner, NO branch-name field (correctly hidden for type=tenant). Clicking 'Pay …' fires exactly ONE POST /api/tenants/checkout/order → 200, then successfully opens the real Razorpay Standard Checkout modal (api.razorpay.com iframe) showing brand 'ParlourPilot', Total Amount 999, and prefills email admin@glowup.com. Staff user clicks Renew → URL stays at /subscription (guard works — no navigation to /checkout). Idempotent-verify path and true-success verify path cannot be exercised end-to-end from CI (real captured payment required); the code path is reviewed and mirrors the branch-verify implementation (guarded by `if order.status=='paid': return {ok:true, idempotent:true}`).

issues: Console warning (carry-over from iter13): 'shadow*' style props deprecated in RN-Web. Use boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts shadows.card used across /checkout & /subscription.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from a third-party RN component; non-blocking.

action_items: P3 (carry-over from iter13): The pending_orders collection has no TTL — abandoned tenant-subscription orders (user opens Razorpay, closes modal, never returns) accumulate as status='created' forever. Recommend a TTL index on pending_orders.created_at (24h) so garbage collection is automatic.

P3 (informational, not blocking): On react-native-web, Alert.alert() is largely a no-op — the 'Owner action required' message will not be visible to a staff user in the web preview (they will just see nothing happen; the guard IS active because URL doesn't change, so they can't accidentally hit the paid flow). On a real device (iOS/Android build) the Alert renders normally. If web parity matters, replace Alert.alert with a custom in-DOM banner/modal for /subscription.

P3 (nice-to-have): The mailto: opens the OS mail client on native, and on web via `window.location.href = 'mailto:...'` — in a Chromium headless environment this is silently swallowed. On a real user browser it triggers the default mail handler correctly. Consider adding a fallback UI (copy-to-clipboard button for support@parlourpilot.com) for users whose browsers block mailto.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: /tenants/checkout/order uses require_admin (NOT require_admin_active) — this is critical because expired tenants MUST be able to renew. Confirmed by test_staff_forbidden (staff 403) AND by admin@glowup.com being able to create orders even though its subscription state is not always 'active'.

GOOD: /tenants/checkout/verify order-lookup includes tenant_id AND user_id AND type='tenant_subscription' — perfect tenant + type + user isolation. Verified: a fresh other-tenant's admin cannot verify glowup's order (returns 404).

GOOD: Signature verification uses hmac.compare_digest (constant-time). After signature passes, an additional payment.fetch call verifies with Razorpay that (a) payment.order_id matches and (b) payment.status is 'captured'/'authorized' — defense in depth.

GOOD: _activate_tenant_from_order correctly extends from the LATER of (now, current subscription_end_date) — so paying yearly on an active 6-month remaining plan gives 6+12 months, not 12 months total. Records to both `payments` and `subscription_history` audit collections.

GOOD: Idempotency guard: `if order.get('status') == 'paid': return {..., idempotent: True}` BEFORE re-activating. And the pending_orders.update_one uses `status: {'$ne':'paid'}` filter with modified_count check — race-safe.

GOOD: GET /api/pay/{order_id} dispatches on order.type — HTML renders 'Salon subscription' label and posts to /api/tenants/checkout/verify for tenant orders; verified via test_pay_page_for_tenant_order + test_branch_checkout_still_works (branch path shows 'Branch monthly subscription' + posts to /branches/checkout/verify).

MINOR: subscription.tsx openSupport builds the mailto with encodeURIComponent for subject AND body — good. Includes business_name, email, subscription status, plan, tenant_id — matches ticket requirement.

MINOR: checkout.tsx branches on `params.type === 'tenant'` for BOTH order creation AND verify function selection — correct. `canPay` is true immediately for tenant (no branch-name required), false for branch until name is filled — verified in the running app.

MINOR: server.py is now ~3441 lines (grew from ~3200 in iter13). The tenant checkout block (lines 1115–1293) is well-scoped but the file continues to be a candidate for modularisation (routers/, services/) — not blocking.
